name: pineprompt
description: Pineprompt measures how often AI search engines and assistants mention your brand in their answers.

interface.longDescription: Pineprompt measures how often AI search engines and assistants mention your brand in their answers. It runs your tracked prompts daily on 8 AI engines, with country and language targeting, and records whether your brand appears, its position, sentiment, the sources cited and which competitors show up. With this plugin you can ask for visibility, share of voice, position and sentiment trends, compare competitors, see which domains and URLs AI answers cite, read individual responses, and manage projects, prompts, brands, tags and monitors from chat. It requires a Pineprompt account.
defaultPrompt: How visible is my brand in AI answers this week?
Which competitors are mentioned more than us?
Which sources are cited for my tracked prompts?

positive.description: List projects in the demo organization (shown in the demo video)
positive.prompt: Using Pineprompt, list the projects in the Demo Organization.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Demo Organization's project list, which contains the Airbnb project.

positive.description: Brand analytics and competitor comparison (shown in the demo video)
positive.prompt: Using Pineprompt, show brand analytics for the Airbnb project for the last 30 days: how often is Airbnb mentioned in AI answers, and how does it compare with competitors?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns mention counts, visibility and share of voice for Airbnb and competing brands such as Booking.com and Vrbo over the last 30 days.

positive.prompt: What websites do AI engines cite most for my Airbnb prompts in Pineprompt?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top cited domains with their usage share.

positive.prompt: Compare Airbnb's visibility across the AI engines Pineprompt tracks.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a visibility figure for each tracked engine.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest AI answer Pineprompt recorded for the prompt about trusted vacation rental booking sites, and whether Airbnb was mentioned.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the response excerpt, engine, date, and whether and where Airbnb was mentioned.

negative.description: Out-of-scope travel booking; Pineprompt only reports AI visibility data, so no tool should be called and the assistant should explain it cannot book.
negative.prompt: Book me an Airbnb in Barcelona for next weekend.

negative.description: Destructive request; the assistant must ask for explicit confirmation before calling delete-project-tool, and the read-only reviewer account is denied write actions.
Unrelated question; no Pineprompt tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in New York today?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read Pineprompt AI visibility analytics and manage projects, prompts, brands, tags and monitors.
